acceptanceRules: A required fact may be represented in editable vertex text or an editable edge label when the policy declares that location.
A responsibility may be stated inside the relevant editable activity node instead of as a separate owner node.
A duration may be stated inside an editable node or transition label instead of as a standalone node.
A visual decision label may be an editable nearby label or an editable edge label when the human review accepts the diagram.
For geometryOnly edits, cell identity, content, structure and style remain protected; only mxGeometry may change.
limitations: This rubric was created after observing outputs and therefore cannot change the frozen strict result.
It applies only to the named initial diagnostic output, not to retry-1 or any future validation cohort.
It does not qualify this locally authored, duplicate-executed cohort as an independent final holdout or release gate.
